story.summaryEn: Ferrari boss Frederic Vasseur admits the team cannot work in "perfect serenity" amid persistent speculation about his future, which was heightened by Christian Horner's comments about Formula 1's "dream" job.
detailZh: 法拉利车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔表示，克里斯蒂安·霍纳是在“找工作”，这加剧了围绕这支F1车队的令人“沮丧”的猜测。
前红牛高层克里斯蒂安·霍纳表示，法拉利是唯一一支他会在不持有股权的情况下考虑重返F1的车队；天空体育F1将从周五上午起直播F1重返马来西亚的比赛，雪邦赛道将承办巴林大奖赛。
雅克·维伦纽夫在霍纳称法拉利是F1中“梦幻”车队之后，就其加盟法拉利的可能性发表了看法。
弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔承认，在关于他未来的持续猜测中，法拉利无法在“完美的安宁”中工作，而克里斯蒂安·霍纳关于F1“梦幻”职位的言论进一步加剧了这种猜测。
瓦塞尔于2023年从索伯加盟法拉利担任车队领队，在经历糟糕的2025年之后，他见证了车队今年重回争冠行列，但近几个月来，他们向梅赛德斯发起的世界冠军挑战逐渐消退，因为在连续五场比赛中未能登上领奖台。
在上周接受《泰晤士报》的采访中，前红牛车队领队霍纳表示，法拉利是他唯一愿意在不持有股权的情况下重返指挥墙的车队，而股权一直是他对任何回归这项运动的优先考虑条件。

在周日阿塞拜疆大奖赛（他的两名车手分别获得第四名和第六名）之后，当被问及近期围绕他和车队的外界噪音是否对他们造成影响时，瓦塞尔承认这确实令人沮丧。
"我们的工作环境并不算完全平静，"瓦塞尔说道。
"对我来说，首先是如此，对车队里的每个人、对媒体、对这些占了一半的问题来说，也是如此。我觉得这是一个有点令人沮丧的局面。
"我们正在为锦标赛第二名的争夺而战。但到头来，我们大家都在不停地谈论这件事，甚至车库里的技师们也在讨论它，这并不是我们所能拥有的最好的讨论。
"但事情就是这样，这不在我掌握之中。
克里斯蒂安·霍纳在今年英国大奖赛回到围场时接受了天空体育记者克雷格·斯莱特的采访。
提及他在红牛的前任 对应职位者霍纳时，瓦塞尔补充道："霍纳先生正在找工作。所有人都知道，到处都知道。"
"我能做什么？我只是尽力推动车队，要求车队保持斗志，专注于今天什么才是最有利的，而不是把时间花在八卦上。"
"每场采访里，这种问题一天要出现25次。"
2026年阿塞拜疆大奖赛的精彩集锦。
瓦塞尔去年签署了多年的续约合同，并表示自己对这个职位的投入毋庸置疑，他正努力带领F1最著名的车队重回世界冠军的轨道，这是车队自2008年以来从未再染指的荣耀。
“当然。这项运动就是我的生命，也是我的事业，”58岁的瓦塞尔说。“我在尽自己最大的努力。当然，我在这里就是为了做好我的工作。我拥有世界上最好的工作。”
“事情就是这样。我们还有七场比赛要打，我们会拼到最后一个弯角。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿将瓦塞尔的存在列为他2025年从梅赛德斯转投法拉利的一个重要原因，两人曾在青训系列赛事中合作过。巴库大奖赛结束后，当天空体育F1问这位七届世界冠军，在瓦塞尔掌舵下车队是否仍处于良好的前进轨道上时，他回答“是的”。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿回顾了他的阿塞拜疆大奖赛，本站他获得第六名。
维伦纽夫：霍纳是必须纳入考虑的人选
早在2025年7月被红牛解雇之前，多年来霍纳就时常与法拉利传出绯闻，原因是他曾带领红牛这支车队的竞争对手赢得八次车手世界冠军和六次车队世界冠军的辉煌成就。
天空体育F1评论员雅克·维伦纽夫认为，霍纳目前处于可引进状态，任何车队都必须将他纳入考虑。
“克里斯蒂安·霍纳是一个你必须认真对待并加以考虑的人，因为他打造了那支常胜的红牛车队。”这位1997年的世界冠军在巴库接受天空体育新闻采访时说。
“他身上有很多非常优秀且积极的履历，充满成功，所以你必须把这一点纳入考量。”
天空体育的克雷格·斯莱特回顾了克里斯蒂安·霍纳担任红牛首席执行官兼车队领队的20年历程。
“我不会说这对现任者来说很可怕，但你必须时刻保持警惕。”
瓦塞尔在2023赛季初从外部被聘请过来，成为法拉利九年内第五任车队领队，目前这个赛季是他在任的第四年。
维伦纽夫补充道：“法拉利不是一个容易待的地方。我们已经见过太多变动——干个两三年，然后就换下一个人，因为成绩出不来。
“所以你随时都坐在一个可以弹射出去的座位上，必须小心谨慎。”

detailEn: Ferrari boss Frederic Vasseur says Christian Horner 'looking for a job' adding to 'frustrating' speculation around F1 team

Ex-Red Bull chief Christian Horner said Ferrari would be the only team he would consider coming back to F1 for without an ownership stake; watch Formula 1's return to Malaysia from Friday morning live on Sky Sports F1 as Sepang hosts the Bahrain Grand Prix
Jacques Villeneuve comments on the likelihood of Christian Horner joining Ferrari following his comments the team is 'the dream' in F1.

Frederic Vasseur admits Ferrari are not able to work in "perfect serenity" amid persistent speculation about his future, which was heightened after comments from Christian Horner about Formula 1's "dream" job.

Vasseur, who joined Ferrari as team principal from Sauber in 2023, has an overseen their return to race-winning ways this year after a poor 2025 but their world championship challenge to Mercedes has faded in recent months amid a five-race run without a podium finish.

In an interview with The Times published last week, former Red Bull team principal Horner said Ferrari were the only team he would consider returning to the pit-wall for without the ownership stake that he has been prioritising for any comeback to the sport.

Asked after Sunday's Azerbaijan Grand Prix, in which his drivers finished fourth and sixth, whether the external noise around him and the team recently was affecting them, Vasseur conceded it was frustrating.
"We are not working in perfect serenity," said Vasseur.
"For me, first, but for everybody in the team, for the media, for the 50 per cent of the questions about this. I think it's a bit of a frustrating situation.

"We are fighting for P2 in the championship. At the end of the day, we are all speaking a lot about this, and even for the guys in the garage to discuss about this, it's not the best discussion that we can have.
"But it is what it is, it's not in my hands."
Christian Horner spoke to Craig Slater when he returned to the paddock at this year's British Grand Prix.
Referencing his former Red Bull counterpart, Vasseur added: "Mr Horner is looking for a job. Everybody knows, everywhere.
"What can I do? I just try to do my best to push the team, to ask the team to be motivated, focus on what is better today, and not to spend time with gossips.
"In each interview, it will be 25 times a day."
Highlights from the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

Vasseur signed a multi-year contract extension last year and said there was no doubt about his commitment to the role as he bids to lead F1's most-famous team back to world title-winning ways for the first time since 2008.
"For sure. The sport is my life, it's my business," said the 58-year-old Vasseur. "I'm trying to do my best. For sure, I'm there to do my job. I have the best job in the world.
"It is like it is. We still have seven races to go and we will push to the last corner."

Lewis Hamilton credited the presence of Vasseur, who he worked with in junior series, as a central reason for him joining Ferrari from Mercedes in 2025. The seven-time world champion replied "yes" when asked by Sky Sports F1 after the Baku race whether the team remained on a good path forward with Vasseur at the helm.
Lewis Hamilton reflects on his Azerbaijan Grand Prix, which saw him finish sixth.
Villeneuve: Horner someone you must have under consideration

Even before he was sacked by Red Bull in July 2025, Horner had been intermittently linked with Ferrari over the years owing to the success which saw the Briton lead their rivals to eight drivers' and six constructors' world titles.
Sky Sports F1 pundit Jacques Villeneuve believes Horner's availability has to be a consideration for a team.
"Christian Horner is someone you have to take seriously and under consideration because he built up the winning Red Bull team," the 1997 world champion told Sky Sports News in Baku.
"He has a lot of very good and positive baggage, full of successes so you have to take that into consideration.
Sky Sports' Craig Slater takes a look back at Christian Horner's 20-year run as Red Bull CEO and team principal.
"I wouldn't say it's scary for who is in place, but you need to be on your toes."
Vasseur became Ferrari's fifth team principal in nine years when he was hired from the start of the 2023 season, with the current campaign his fourth in charge.
Villeneuve added: "Ferrari is not an easy place to be. We have seen so many changes - two or three years, next one, because the results don't come.
"So you are always on an ejectable seat and you have to be careful."

勒克莱尔：成为父亲是最特别的事情
勒克莱尔的妻子亚历山德拉周三诞下女儿比安卡后，他晚些时候才抵达巴西。
这位29岁的车手成为当前发车区第五位当父亲的一级方程式车手，前四位是马克斯·维斯塔潘、费尔南多·阿隆索、尼科·霍肯伯格和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯。
“这绝对是最特别的事情，”他说。
“你多少会期待这一刻，因为我一直想当个年轻爸爸，而且显然和亚历克斯在一起时，我们觉得时机对了，这是一个非常、非常特别的时刻。这一周绝对会因为我永远记住，全是积极的理由。
“当然，这期间也发生了其他事情。但对我来说，这一周全是关于比安卡的，真是太不可思议了。”

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Charles Leclerc plans 'significant' Ferrari car changes as Lewis Hamilton rues 'difficult' Brazil practice

Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc says he will make "significant" setup changes to his car after "one of the worst feelings" in practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Leclerc was seven tenths off pace-setter Kimi Antonelli in second practice and Lewis Hamilton was nearly half a second behind as Ferrari trailed Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday.

It was a contrast to their recent pace with Ferrari claiming a podium position in the last four races but Leclerc is hoping they can turn that around in final practice on Saturday at 2.30pm and qualifying at 6pm, live on Sky Sports F1.

"I've got some ideas. We'll change the car quite significantly, and we'll see how it goes. I hope we can do a step forward because even though I missed FP1, I don't think there was much performance in that.

Leclerc: Most special thing ever to become a father
Leclerc arrived late to Brazil after his wife Alexandra gave birth to a baby girl named Bianca on Wednesday.
The 29-year-old becomes the fifth Formula 1 driver on the current grid to be a father after Max Verstappen, Fernando Alonso, Nico Hulkenberg and Sergio Perez.
"It's definitely the most special thing ever," he said.

"You kind of expect it because I've always wanted to be a young dad, and obviously with Alex we felt like it was the right time, and it's a very, very special moment. Definitely a week I'll forever remember for all the positive reasons.
"Of course, there's been other things going on as well. But for me, this week was all about Bianca, and it's been it's been incredible."

detailZh: 圣保罗大奖赛：安东内利在英特拉戈斯赛道以梅赛德斯赛车领跑，领先于升级后的迈凯伦车手诺里斯。

圣保罗大奖赛周五练习赛精彩瞬间回顾。
作为F1新世界冠军，安东内利在赛道上完成了令人印象深刻的首日，并在圣保罗大奖赛第二场练习赛中设定了节奏。
在墨西哥成为该运动最年轻冠军五天后，安东内利在第一场练习中取得了第二快的成绩，并在蜿蜒的英特拉戈斯赛道上完成了更具代表性的第二场练习的最快成绩。
安东内利是唯一一位在圈速低于71秒的车手，他的基准时间1:10.763比最接近的挑战者兰多·诺里斯、P1的领跑者以及马克斯·维斯塔潘快了二十分之一秒。

但是，在周五的比赛中，诺里斯凭借自己最快的和第二快的成绩，也可以对自己的表现感到满意，因为麦凯轮车队对其MCL40赛车进行了升级。去年世界冠军，去年在圣保罗的获胜者，在长距离的比赛中也表现出色。
沃金车队是本周末唯一一支使用新部件的车队，他们试图在最后四轮比赛中反击红牛车队，在车队积分榜上超越对手，因为他们在维斯特潘在四场比赛中赢得三场胜利后，被对手超越了第三名。
乔治·拉塞尔紧随诺里斯和维斯特潘之后，在第二辆梅赛德斯赛车中排名第四快。他因为更换了新引擎，在本周末的比赛中将面临五位的发车位罚分。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在另一辆麦凯轮赛车中排名第六。
但是，对于法拉利来说，这似乎是赛道上的一个更艰难的第一天，尤其是在短距离的比赛中。
在墨西哥站第一圈发生碰撞导致车队失去了一次可能的胜利，并促使周四晚上车手与车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔举行会议以澄清情况后，刘易斯·汉密尔顿以第六快的成绩，查尔斯·勒克莱尔以第七快的成绩。
法拉利车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔在两位车手之间发生公开争执后，回答了关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题。
勒克莱尔在错过周四的媒体日和周五的第一节练习后，在周一从摩纳哥飞回，因为他的第一个孩子比安卡出生。
奥迪车队的尼古拉斯·胡肯伯格是经验丰富的车手中之一，他缺席了新手的开幕式练习，而可靠性问题导致他整日没有完成任何一圈。
在第一节的比赛中，英国年轻车手弗雷迪·斯莱特在仅仅完成了七圈后遇到了技术问题，而车队在第二小时努力修理它时，一个电气问题使得赛车在剩余的时间里都无法参赛。

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Kimi Antonelli fastest for Mercedes in second practice at Interlagos ahead of Lando Norris in upgraded McLaren
Watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Kimi Antonelli completed an impressive first day back on track as F1's new world champion to set the pace in second practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.

Five days after becoming the sport's youngest title winner in Mexico, Antonelli followed up his second-fastest time from first practice with the quickest of the more representative second session around the undulating Interlagos lap.

Antonelli was the only driver to lap below 71 seconds with his benchmark time of 1:10.763 proving two tenths of a second quicker than nearest challengers Lando Norris, the P1 pacesetter, and Max Verstappen.

But with fastest and second-fastest times of his own from Friday, Norris can also be satisfied with his day after McLaren introduced an upgrade to their MCL40 cars. The outgoing world champion, last year's winner in Sao Paulo, appeared quick on the longer runs too.

The Woking team are the only team in the field with new parts this weekend as they bid to hit back against Red Bull in the Constructors' Championship over the final four rounds after being overtaken for third by their rivals after Verstappen's run of three wins in four races.

George Russell was close behind Norris and Verstappen to finish fourth fastest in the second Mercedes. He carries a five-place grid penalty for a fresh engine into the weekend. Oscar Piastri was sixth in the other McLaren.
But it appeared a more difficult first day on track for Ferrari, particularly on the short runs.

Following the first-lap clash that cost the team a likely victory in Mexico, and prompted a Thursday evening meeting between the drivers and team principal Frederic Vasseur to clear the air, Lewis Hamilton was sixth fastest with Charles Leclerc seventh.
Ferrari Team Principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after a public spat between the two,
Leclerc returned to the track after missing Thursday's media day and then Friday's first session after flying back from Monaco following the birth of his first child, Bianca, earlier this week.
Audi's Nico Hulkenberg was among the experienced drivers to sit out the opening session for rookies and reliability problems meant he ended the day without a lap on the board at all.

A technical problem had already stopped British youngster Freddie Slater after just seven laps while he was in the car in the first session and, while the team worked to repair it for the second hour, an electrical problem kept it sidelined for the rest of the day.
